content: Njan keyoh whuti Babylon 'awet musai whuzdli'
'Et ndo ho hukw'elh'az 'uyoon lizas yak'uz ndus de út'o whe tís'en. Soo ulhtus whe k'úne' 'ut'en doút'en. Oots'u hánuyuzduz-i ndi yun k'ut be hóot'en.

content.text: ndi ntsi'-i nududeh-i lhai bukeyoh whúzdli'.
Ndai la dut'ai dutsun 'ink'ez oots'o dutni-i,
Soo nint'i whe 'uyoon dune bulh ninta' 'ut'ih,
ts'ekoo too' k'un'a 'udun yun k'ut whut'enne,
Ndi yun k'ut whulerwene cha huyulh ninta' ut'ih inle'.

content: 'Et doo cha ndus de yak'uz ts'e 'uwhutni whudásts'o whe nja duwhútni,

content.text: “Sdune'ne oots'u hanáhdilh doo ka si 'en bulh lubeshi 'oolh'en.
'Ink'ez doo ka si ndi dune ye dzoh nudeh-i,
Oolubeshi ndo yat'ah ts'e 'udiltai suli' 'et huwa.
Danóhinla-un whuz un'a za ooba 'uk'elha hoolhtsi.
Duba nacha 'ink'ez whudízti' hukw'un'a za yinka usda,
whuz un'a dzoh nuzut 'ink'ez ts'odi unli-un oogha óonah'aih.
'ilhoh dzin za 'et ndi ts'iyawh oogha whútalts'ulh.

content: Ndun Babylon musai whuzdli'-un hukw'e hunudleh
“Ndi yun k'ut whulerwene yulh ninta' 'ut'ihne, 'enne soo hiyulh hoonzoo 'ant'e'ne ndi dizk'un whe oolut hinilh'en de, hik'e titso 'ink'ez hik'e ni untileh.
Ndi ye dzoh nadinzut-i hinilh'en 'ink'ez hiye nuljut 'inka yoo 'un cho nódilhya 'ink'ez 'uhutni,

content.text: 'ilhoh sadzi huk'oh hunist'o-un, 'et mba nahisda-un, whusahóolts'ut.’

content: 'Et whu la gha ts'e ndi yun k'ut 'e'óoketne hik'e titso 'ink'ez 'enne cha hik'e ntidleh. Ndai la hiye ooket-i, 'aw dune lhuhuyoosket suli' 'et huwa.

Gold, 'ink'ez silver, 'ink'ez tse dunizti'-i, 'ink'ez kw'usul dunízti'-i, 'ink'ez naih dízti'-i, 'ink'ez naih dulk'un 'ankw'us dulhk'us, luswe soo dulk'un-i, khuna-i ncha-i oode, ivory huyúlhni, hoonliyaz hiyilh'i-i ts'iyai dizti'-i duchun, dulk'un t'eh, iron, tse marble huyulhni, 'ants'i ts'iyai dizti'-i,

'ink'ez bulh buta'whut'en-i cinnamon huyulhni, 'ink'ez sooltsun-i dizk'un-i, khe sooltsun-i, yoo Frankincense huyulhni, ts'ekoo too', 'ink'ez khe olive huyulhni, lhes 'ink'ez lhes hanúyeh-i, 'ink'ez musdoos 'ink'ez 'usbai, yeztli 'ink'ez nuyúlhgoo-i tubulh, dune yust'e 'ink'ez buzul cha, ts'iyawh be 'óoket.”

'Et 'uhutni, “'Ink'ez soo t'alh-i unzoo-i za kúndunut'a, ndai la tube hika' ninzun-i, 'i cha ts'iyawh nch'a hooloh suli'. Ndai la dizti'-i 'ink'ez soo 'ot'en-i, 'ohwhi ts'iyawh nch'a hooloh suli', 'aw naóonlelh ait'oh.”

Mbene la ndowhi be óoketne, 'enne la ndun ts'eke hoonzoo 'unt'oh ubulhtsine, ndun ts'eke ye dzoh nuzut-i, 'i hiyé nuljut 'inka yoo 'un cho highu núdilhya 'ink'ez tube cho hutso, 'ink'ez hukw'e ni nahunudleh.

content.text: Nyo keyoh whut'i naih dulk'un-i 'ankwus dulhk'us,
Soo ts'ih'un 'ilhoh sadzi ha' hunit'o-un ndi whe' hoonzoo' hoont'oh-i cho, gak whuzdli'.”

content: 'Ink'ez mbene la ts'i cho be nukene, 'ink'ez bumoodihne cha, mbene la whuz un'a 'e'hooket 'ink'ez 'oohooketne, 'enne ts'iyawh yoo 'un cho nuhúdilhya.
'Ink'ez nyoo dizk'un oolut, 'et hinalh'en whe tube cho nja nduhútni, “'Aw ndóohoont'oh-un keyoh whuti 'aw 'udun whuz un'a keyoh whuti hooloh!”

content.text: Nyo keyoh whuti ts'i yatoo k'ut núkat-i ts'iyawh hoonzoo' hint'oh ubulhtsi.
'Ilho sadzi ha' hunit'o-un soo ts'ih'un gak whuzdli'.”
“Nohni yak'uz whut'enne 'ink'ez nohni Yak'usda ooch'e'ne 'ink'ez nohni whel'a'ne,
'ink'ez nus hoo'enne cha ndun ts'eke 'ul'en-un bulh dahooja,
Nts'en'a la nohba nahizya whuz un'a Yak'usda nohba yuk'elha whulhtsi 'et huwa.”

content: 'Et lizas ulhtus-un tse cho ook'ut lhes dunutsut-i ndoút'en-i, 'i yílhchoot 'ink'ez yatoo k'ut taínalh'uz. 'Ink'ez 'utni,

content.text: “Soo wheóonujut whe keyoh whuti Babylon whuz un'a Yak'usda nawhúntiyus 'ink'ez 'aw 'on 'at dune nahó'alh ait'oh.
'Ink'ez tse k'ut lhes hundunutsut-un be duts'o-i 'et cha 'ilhiz 'etsul 'uwhudutánelh,
Mbene la mba 'e'óoketne ndi yun k'ut dune nchane 'uhant'e'.
Duyun-un k'un'a ndi yun k'ut dune lhelhdowh didowhne nyun nabunan'a 'et huwa.
